string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_summary
string.translation: Expanded suggestion bar with multi-row words and swipe navigation

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_topbar_scale_summary
string.translation: Adjust the height and text size of the suggestion bar

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_invert_swipe_summary
string.translation: Reverse vertical swipe direction when picking suggestions from the upper or lower row

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_swipe_sensitivity_summary
string.translation: Higher values require shorter horizontal swipes to switch words

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_multi_word_select_summary

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_summary
string.translation: Swipe words with two fingers at once, while single-finger glide typing stays normal

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_enabled_summary
string.translation: Use both thumbs to swipe parts of a word together. Single-finger swiping still works as usual.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_auto_space_summary
string.translation: Automatically insert spaces between two-finger words

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_space_placement_summary
string.translation: Choose whether spaces are added before the next word or after each word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_auto_space_delay_summary
string.translation: How long to wait after lifting your fingers before finalizing the word and adding a space

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_combine_enabled_summary
string.translation: Combine quick single-finger swipes into one word instead of starting a new word each time

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_combine_delay_summary
string.translation: How long to wait for the next swipe before treating it as a new word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_tap_to_multiswipe_enabled_title
string.translation: Continue tapped letters with a swipe

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_tap_to_multiswipe_enabled_summary
string.translation: If you tap a few letters and then swipe with two fingers, combine them into one word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_tap_to_multiswipe_delay_summary
string.translation: How long recent letter taps count toward a two-finger swipe

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_spacebar_timer_indicator_summary
string.translation: Display a visual bar on the spacebar while waiting to finish the word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_word_ready_vibration_title
string.translation: Vibrate when ready for new word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_word_ready_vibration_summary
string.translation: Give a subtle vibration when the word timer expires and a new word can begin

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_backspace_mode_summary
string.translation: What Backspace does right after a two-finger swipe

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_backspace_mode_last_input
string.translation: Undo last swipe or tap before word is finished

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_summary
string.translation: Fine-tune swipe accuracy vs. common-word preference

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_header_summary
string.translation: Adjust how strictly the decoder follows your exact finger path versus favoring common words. Default values work best for most people.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_beam_width_summary
string.translation: How many word candidates the decoder tracks per letter. Higher values can improve accuracy for long words, but use slightly more battery.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_freq_weight_floor_summary
string.translation: Prevent common words from overriding rare words you swiped accurately. Higher = easier to type uncommon words.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_geo_exponent_summary
string.translation: How closely your swipe must match the exact letters. Higher = follow your path strictly; lower = allow messier swipes.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_beam_freq_weight_summary
string.translation: How strongly everyday words are preferred while matching your swipe. 0 = match finger path only.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_error_summary
string.translation: The MultiSwipe settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_diagnostics_summary
string.translation: Record and export logs for troubleshooting

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_trace_logging_summary
string.translation: Record touch paths, timings, and decoder candidates to local trace logs for troubleshooting.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_trace_export_summary
string.translation: Choose how many minutes back to export recorded trace events as JSONL.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_trace_export_error
string.translation: Enter a duration between 1 and 1440 minutes.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_trace_export_empty
string.translation: No trace log entries found in the selected time window.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_trace_clear_summary
string.translation: Delete locally stored MultiSwipe trace log files.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiswipe_trace_clear_confirm_message
string.translation: Delete all recorded MultiSwipe trace log files?

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_reset_summary
string.translation: Restore all decoder parameters to their default values

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: Search depth, rare word boost, path strictness, and common word preference will be restored to defaults.
